title: Trump Wants to Control Voting, ICE Backs Off in Minnesota & Epstein Redactions Protecting Creeps
text: Trump Wants to Control Voting, ICE Backs Off in Minnesota & Epstein Redactions Protecting CreepsThe Winter Olympics are officially underway in Milan, Italy, the 150th Westminster Kennel Club Dog Show took place last night, Tom Homan announced that the government is finally backing off and pulling 700 ICE agents out of Minnesota, Trump is calling on Republicans to nationalize voting and take over in about fifteen states, Steve Bannon is openly calling for armed ICE agents outside the polls on election day, the Melania documentary allegedly exceeded box office expectations, it has a score of 5% on Rotten Tomatoes from 39 critics and a 99% audience score which we are sure has nothing to do with Donald Trump, Nicki Minaj sat down with Stephen Miller’s wife to talk about how her support from Trump might one day express itself in her music, the DOJ and FBI seem to be redacting names that shouldn’t be, a lizard edition of This Week in Florida, and we are joined by RFK Junior Jr. who has some healthy Super Bowl snack ideas.
